methods: Construct and independently check one source-bound instance of the stated first experiment.

original_card.acceptance_gate: A source-bound arbitrary-input identity and legal producer/consumer boundary with the complete paid and productive target invoice, including restoration, ownership, native alignment and extra charges. A scoped local result remains useful; expansion requires the family-level budget gate.
